answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that behaves like a marble dropped into a canyon: cheap to place once, but an attacker spawning thousands must pay for every marble, and the canyon keeps the cost. Pair that bond with a crystal-clear public ledger of past work, so peers attest only identities whose history they can inspect. Misbehavior slashes the stake and burns the reputation, making a Sybil flood cost far more than any reward it could harvest.
